# Baby quilt: agreed layout

Settled with Mum on 12 October. Nothing has changed since.

- The quilt top is 5 blocks across and 7 blocks down, so 35 blocks.
- Every block is a nine-patch: 3 rows of 3 squares. The 4 corner squares are blue, the 4 edge squares are white and the centre square is yellow.
- The middle block (row 4, column 3) is the exception. It is not a nine-patch but one plain white label square, the size of a whole block. It is cut as its own piece and listed on its own line.
- All the small squares are cut to the same size, shown in the cutting list.
- A plain border goes round the top, cut as four strips: one for each side.
- The back is one piece of backing, and one piece of wadding goes between the layers.
